newsitem.title: JORDAN: Israeli woman stabbed in north Jordan, doctor says.
newsitem.headline: Israeli woman stabbed in north Jordan, doctor says.

text.p: An Israeli woman was stabbed in northern Jordan on Wednesday, a Jordanian doctor said.
The doctor at the Yarmouk Health Centre near the city of Irbid said the 30-year-old woman was treated for a knife wound in the stomach but was released after less than an hour.
He said the incident took place near the popular tourist site of Umm Queis, an old Roman city overlooking the Sea of Galilee and the Golan Heights.
Jordanian officials were not immediately available to comment on the attack.
In March, a Jordanian soldier shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls just a few km (miles) from Umm Qeis in Baqoura, on Jordanian territory leased to Israel under a 1994 peace treaty.
